title: Personal mobility vehicles and methods
abstract: An automatically balancing vehicle having a headroom monitor. The headroom monitor determines the difference between the maximum velocity of the vehicle and the present velocity of the vehicle. An alarm receives a signal from the headroom monitor and produces a warning when the headroom falls below a specified limit.
gist: The invention describes self-balancing personal transport devices (the Segway) with motorized ground-contact members that maintain stability dynamically rather than statically. Users stand on a platform while the control system automatically balances by adjusting motor-driven wheels.
